plan.english: The truth is strong, and it does not die; the lie is weak. He who deceives fears the light. The feet of a lie are short.

clauses.english: The truth is strong, and it does not die; the lie is weak.
He who deceives fears the light.
The feet of a lie are short.

plan.english: What the heart thinks, the tongue says. The mouth of the wise man is in his heart. The heart of the bad man is in his mouth.

clauses.english: What the heart thinks, the tongue says.
The mouth of the wise man is in his heart.
The heart of the bad man is in his mouth.

plan.english: Son, listen to your father. Hear many things, and say few. Speak the truth to mortals. Do not deceive your friend. A lie is a snake. It devours him who carries it.

clauses.english: Son, listen to your father.
Hear many things, and say few.
Speak the truth to mortals.
Do not deceive your friend.
A lie is a snake.
It devours him who carries it.

plan.english: Fire burns the hand; a bad word burns the heart. Smoke follows fire, and grief follows a lie. The hand becomes whole again; the heart does not become whole.

clauses.english: Fire burns the hand; a bad word burns the heart.
Smoke follows fire, and grief follows a lie.
The hand becomes whole again; the heart does not become whole.

plan.english: Cattle die, brothers die, and the mortal dies. Good fame does not die. The imperishable fame of a man lives.

clauses.english: Cattle die, brothers die, and the mortal dies.
Good fame does not die.
The imperishable fame of a man lives.

plan.english: Father, what is sweet in the mouth? A lie. What is bitter in the heart? The same lie. Speak the truth, son. The truth is bitter in the mouth, and it is sweet in the heart.

clauses.english: Father, what is sweet in the mouth?
A lie.
What is bitter in the heart?
The same lie.
Speak the truth, son.
The truth is bitter in the mouth, and it is sweet in the heart.

plan.english: A lie is a thief. It does not steal cattle; it steals the minds of mortals. It does not come by night; it comes by day. Guard your mind by day and by night.

clauses.english: A lie is a thief.
It does not steal cattle; it steals the minds of mortals.
It does not come by night; it comes by day.
Guard your mind by day and by night.

title: An old man to the young

plan.english: Listen, young men, to an old man. An old man has seen many things. Do not trust a sweet tongue. It leads young men to the wolf. Trust a straight word.

clauses.english: Listen, young men, to an old man.
An old man has seen many things.
Do not trust a sweet tongue.
It leads young men to the wolf.
Trust a straight word.

plan.english: Many words, few deeds. The ill-minded man talks; the good man works. Deeds point out the man.

clauses.english: Many words, few deeds.
The ill-minded man talks; the good man works.
Deeds point out the man.

plan.english: Old man, who is a friend? He who tells you the truth is a friend. He who praises you with sweet words is not a friend. He is a wolf.

clauses.english: Old man, who is a friend?
He who tells you the truth is a friend.
He who praises you with sweet words is not a friend.
He is a wolf.

title: The heart wants, the mind chooses

plan.english: The heart wants many things; the mind chooses few. He whose mind is straight walks on a straight path. His feet do not slip.

clauses.english: The heart wants many things; the mind chooses few.
He whose mind is straight walks on a straight path.
His feet do not slip.

plan.english: Daughter, many men are sweet of speech, and they are not true. Look at a man's deeds; do not look at his words. Deeds are true.

clauses.english: Daughter, many men are sweet of speech, and they are not true.
Look at a man's deeds; do not look at his words.
Deeds are true.

title: The wolf and the bad word

plan.english: The wolf kills sheep; a bad word kills a man's name. You see the wolf; you do not see the lie. The dog protects the sheep; the gods protect the name.

clauses.english: The wolf kills sheep; a bad word kills a man's name.
You see the wolf; you do not see the lie.
The dog protects the sheep; the gods protect the name.

plan.english: The good man gives; the bad man takes. What a man gives, that he receives. Good comes to the kindly man.

clauses.english: The good man gives; the bad man takes.
What a man gives, that he receives.
Good comes to the kindly man.

plan.english: Father, where does the truth dwell? The truth dwells in a straight heart. Where does the lie dwell? It dwells in the ill-minded man.

clauses.english: Father, where does the truth dwell?
The truth dwells in a straight heart.
Where does the lie dwell?
It dwells in the ill-minded man.

plan.english: The mouth is the door of the heart. Guard the door. He who is silent does not slip. A lie follows the man of many words.

clauses.english: The mouth is the door of the heart.
Guard the door.
He who is silent does not slip.
A lie follows the man of many words.

plan.english: Young man, yoke your mind. The mind of a man is a swift horse. An unyoked mind slips from the path. He who yokes his mind arrives at his own home.

clauses.english: Young man, yoke your mind.
The mind of a man is a swift horse.
An unyoked mind slips from the path.
He who yokes his mind arrives at his own home.

plan.english: A king's word stands. A deceiving king falls. The gods hear his oath. Let him not break his oath.

clauses.english: A king's word stands.
A deceiving king falls.
The gods hear his oath.
Let him not break his oath.

plan.english: Son, I am old. Hear my words. Do not anger a guest; do not break an oath. Honor the gods, and cherish your mother. May good fame follow you.

clauses.english: Son, I am old.
Hear my words.
Do not anger a guest; do not break an oath.
Honor the gods, and cherish your mother.
May good fame follow you.

plan.english: The eye sees, the ear hears, and the judgement knows. What the eye has seen, that is true. What the ear hears, that is wind.

clauses.english: The eye sees, the ear hears, and the judgement knows.
What the eye has seen, that is true.
What the ear hears, that is wind.

plan.english: A mother's heart does not deceive. The mother knows her son. The child hides nothing from his mother.

clauses.english: A mother's heart does not deceive.
The mother knows her son.
The child hides nothing from his mother.

plan.english: Child, sit down and listen. I have seen many winters. Snow melts in the sun; a lie melts in the light. The truth is a stone; it does not melt.

clauses.english: Child, sit down and listen.
I have seen many winters.
Snow melts in the sun; a lie melts in the light.
The truth is a stone; it does not melt.

plan.english: Two brothers were fighting. Of-Good-Fame said: My word is true. Of-Divine-Race said: Your word is not true. Then the father spoke. Sons, the truth is of one path; the lie is of many paths. Seek that path together. Then the brothers were silent.

clauses.english: Two brothers were fighting.
Of-Good-Fame said: My word is true.
Of-Divine-Race said: Your word is not true.
Then the father spoke.
Sons, the truth is of one path; the lie is of many paths.
Seek that path together.
Then the brothers were silent.

plan.english: The snake creeps under a stone; the lie creeps under sweet words. Lift the stone, and you find the snake.

clauses.english: The snake creeps under a stone; the lie creeps under sweet words.
Lift the stone, and you find the snake.

plan.english: The arms of the young man are strong; the mind of the old man is wise. The young man speaks; the old man is silent and knows. The hand of the young man and the mind of the wise man build a house.

clauses.english: The arms of the young man are strong; the mind of the old man is wise.
The young man speaks; the old man is silent and knows.
The hand of the young man and the mind of the wise man build a house.

plan.english: Gold is lost; great fame is not lost. A thief steals gold; no one steals fame. It is the reward of the guileless man.

clauses.english: Gold is lost; great fame is not lost.
A thief steals gold; no one steals fame.
It is the reward of the guileless man.

plan.english: In the tongue there is no bone, and it breaks bones. Guard it, young man. The word that goes out, no one seizes.

clauses.english: In the tongue there is no bone, and it breaks bones.
Guard it, young man.
The word that goes out, no one seizes.

plan.english: The king asked a wise man: What is strong? The wise man said: Mead is strong. The king is strong, and a woman is strong. The truth overpowers them. Then the king praised him.

clauses.english: The king asked a wise man: What is strong?
The wise man said: Mead is strong.
The king is strong, and a woman is strong.
The truth overpowers them.
Then the king praised him.

plan.english: What the heart wishes, the hand gives. The gift of an ill-minded man is poison. The small gift of a dear friend is great.

clauses.english: What the heart wishes, the hand gives.
The gift of an ill-minded man is poison.
The small gift of a dear friend is great.

plan.english: Child, hear twice; then speak. A swift tongue slips. Let the mind go forward, and let the voice go after.

clauses.english: Child, hear twice; then speak.
A swift tongue slips.
Let the mind go forward, and let the voice go after.

plan.english: Deeds carry fame; words carry wind. The man of good deeds is of good fame.

clauses.english: Deeds carry fame; words carry wind.
The man of good deeds is of good fame.

plan.english: Mother, why do men deceive? Son, he who deceives is afraid, and he who is afraid deceives. He who is not afraid speaks the truth.

clauses.english: Mother, why do men deceive?
Son, he who deceives is afraid, and he who is afraid deceives.
He who is not afraid speaks the truth.

plan.english: A small fire burns a great house. A small lie burns a great name. Do not carry fire in your mouth.

clauses.english: A small fire burns a great house.
A small lie burns a great name.
Do not carry fire in your mouth.

plan.english: Speak the truth to a guest. Do not deceive a stranger. Father Sky protects the guest. He who deceives a guest deceives the gods.

clauses.english: Speak the truth to a guest.
Do not deceive a stranger.
Father Sky protects the guest.
He who deceives a guest deceives the gods.

plan.english: The lie loves darkness; the truth loves light. The thief goes by night; the true man goes by day. The sun sees the deeds of mortals.

clauses.english: The lie loves darkness; the truth loves light.
The thief goes by night; the true man goes by day.
The sun sees the deeds of mortals.

plan.english: Daughter, guard the tongue, the hands and the heart. The tongue wounds, the hand steals, and the heart wants evil things. She who guards these is a good woman.

clauses.english: Daughter, guard the tongue, the hands and the heart.
The tongue wounds, the hand steals, and the heart wants evil things.
She who guards these is a good woman.

plan.english: Truth is in mead. He who drinks mead hides nothing. Grandson, drink, and guard your mind.

clauses.english: Truth is in mead.
He who drinks mead hides nothing.
Grandson, drink, and guard your mind.

title: The wolf who said he was a sheep

plan.english: A wolf came to the sheep and said: I am a sheep. The dog saw his teeth and said: Your voice is the voice of a sheep; your teeth are the teeth of a wolf. The voice is sweet; the teeth are sharp. Then the dog drove him away.

clauses.english: A wolf came to the sheep and said: I am a sheep.
The dog saw his teeth and said:
Your voice is the voice of a sheep; your teeth are the teeth of a wolf.
The voice is sweet; the teeth are sharp.
Then the dog drove him away.

plan.english: When you rage, be silent. When your mind is straight, then speak. The word of a raging man is a spear. It wounds a friend.

clauses.english: When you rage, be silent.
When your mind is straight, then speak.
The word of a raging man is a spear.
It wounds a friend.

plan.english: What a man hides, the gods see. No one deceives the gods. Father Sky looks at mortals.

clauses.english: What a man hides, the gods see.
No one deceives the gods.
Father Sky looks at mortals.
